title.zh: 先缩小问题，再调用模型
title.en: Bound the problem before calling a model

detail.zh: 先拆任务、锁定文件范围、提取依赖和接口；最小上下文不足时才逐层扩展。减少问题规模通常比直接换模型更省 token。
detail.en: Decompose work, bound files, and extract dependencies and contracts. Expand context only when the minimum is insufficient; smaller problems usually save more tokens than switching models.

title.zh: 确定性工具优先

detail.zh: 搜索、测试、静态检查和结构化提取先产生可验证事实；它们不消耗模型 token，也能减少模型猜测。
detail.en: Search, tests, static checks, and structured extraction establish verifiable facts first; they avoid model-token use and reduce guessing.

title.zh: 生成与验证分离，失败才升级
title.en: Separate generation from validation; escalate on evidence

detail.zh: 先用 fast 或 balanced 生成候选，运行定向验收；只有失败、证据不足、跨模块因果复杂或高失败成本时才升级 deep。
detail.en: Generate with fast or balanced first and run targeted acceptance checks. Escalate to deep only after failure, insufficient evidence, complex cross-module causality, or high failure cost.

title.zh: 自动

detail.zh: 根据风险、能力匹配、验收、预算和近期遥测选择最小合适档位。
detail.en: Select the minimum suitable tier from risk, capability fit, acceptance, budget, and recent telemetry.

guardrail.zh: 不会因外部榜单或主观偏好无依据升级。
guardrail.en: Does not upgrade solely for rankings or preference.

title.zh: 速度优先

detail.zh: 对范围明确、低风险、可验证的工作，允许降低一个候选档位以减少等待。
detail.en: For bounded, low-risk, verifiable work, permit one lower candidate tier to reduce waiting.

guardrail.zh: 不会降低 high-risk、deep 或验收所需的档位。
guardrail.en: Never lowers a high-risk, deep, or acceptance-required tier.

title.zh: 质量优先

detail.zh: 对低风险 fast 工作优先采用 balanced 首轮候选，以减少返工，同时仍使用定向验收。
detail.en: For low-risk fast work, prefer a balanced first-pass candidate to reduce rework while retaining targeted acceptance.

guardrail.zh: 不会默认把所有任务升到 deep，也不绕过授权、预算或证据。
guardrail.en: Never sends every task to deep or bypasses authorization, budget, or evidence.

title.zh: 任务能力匹配

detail.zh: 使用与实际任务相近的评测；外部榜单只用于候选筛选，不能替代项目验收。
detail.en: Use task-relevant evaluations; external rankings only screen candidates and never replace project acceptance.

title.zh: 官方能力与价格

detail.zh: 核对上下文、工具、结构化输出、多模态、地区与价格快照；快照超过 30 天不用于自动预算。
detail.en: Verify context, tools, structured output, multimodality, region, and current pricing; snapshots older than 30 days cannot drive automatic budgets.

title.zh: 时延与吞吐

detail.zh: 交互任务看首 token，批量任务看端到端与输出速度；思考时间也计入总时长。
detail.en: Compare time to first token for interactive work and end-to-end/output speed for batch work; thinking time counts.

title.zh: 上下文与工具可行性

detail.zh: 验证 JSON、函数调用、流式、限流与超时；大上下文窗口不等于默认发送全仓库。
detail.en: Check JSON, function calls, streaming, limits, and timeouts; a large context window never means sending the whole repository by default.

title.zh: 供应商运行质量

detail.zh: 同一模型在不同供应商的价格、缓存、时延和功能可能不同；用近 7–30 天遥测校正选择。
detail.en: The same model may differ by provider in price, caching, latency, and features; correct choices with 7–30 day telemetry.

title.zh: 项目内结果与风险

detail.zh: 定向测试、人工审查、重试和回滚风险优先级最高；不可逆或高失败成本才允许预算例外。
detail.en: Targeted tests, human review, retries, and rollback risk take priority; only irreversible or high-cost failures justify budget exceptions.

use.zh: 范围清晰、低风险、可验证的生成或整理。
use.en: Bounded, low-risk, verifiable drafting or organization.

checks.zh: 使用官方 API；先确认 JSON/工具需求、价格快照和本地验证。
checks.en: Use the official API; confirm JSON/tool needs, price snapshot, and local validation first.

use.zh: 常规实现、局部调试和有定向验收的分析。
use.en: Routine implementation, bounded debugging, and analysis with targeted acceptance.

checks.zh: 思考模式需要记录端到端时延与输出 token；涉及工具调用时保留 reasoning_content。
checks.en: Record end-to-end latency and output tokens; preserve reasoning_content across tool-call turns.

use.zh: 跨模块因果、架构取舍、迁移或高失败成本问题。
use.en: Cross-module causality, architecture trade-offs, migrations, or high failure-cost work.

checks.zh: 只有 fast/balanced 验证失败或风险证明充分时升级，并要求授权与成本例外理由。
checks.en: Escalate only after fast/balanced validation fails or risk evidence warrants it, with authorization and cost rationale.

where.zh: Codex、Cursor、自带网页/桌面聊天的模型选择器
where.en: Codex, Cursor, and provider web/desktop model selectors

rule.zh: Skill 输出推荐和验收条件；用户在宿主内切换，Skill 不控制会话模型。
rule.en: The Skill produces a recommendation and acceptance criteria; the user switches in the host, which the Skill cannot control.

where.zh: 本地 Model Router 网关 + per_step 授权
where.en: Local Model Router gateway + per_step authorization

rule.zh: 网关生成计划；每一个模型步骤都需人工批准后，才调用已配置的 API。
rule.en: The gateway creates a plan; every model step requires human approval before the configured API is called.

where.zh: 本地 Model Router 网关 + budget_auto / full_auto
where.en: Local Model Router gateway + budget_auto / full_auto

rule.zh: 仅限 API：白名单、密钥、预算、有效期与已有能力检查满足时可自动执行；证据可逐步补齐，缺失时降级为半自动/人工批准。发布、删除、权限与安全操作仍逐步批准。
rule.en: API only: allowlist, key, budget, expiry, and available capability checks are required. Evidence can be completed incrementally; missing evidence falls back to semi-automatic or manual approval. Publish, delete, permission, and security actions still require step approval.

kind.zh: 官方模型与 Codex 文档
官方价格与 API 能力
独立模型能力、价格与时延测评
kind.en: Independent capability, price, and latency evaluation
